+"""
+EduAgent Interview Coach — Adaptive Question Selection & Mastery Engine
+========================================================================
+
+Implements deterministic, rule-based adaptive follow-up selection and
+session concept mastery tracking matching PRD Section 10.2 and TRD Section 9.
+
+Key design guarantees:
+1. Deterministic: Given the same session state and evaluation, the same next
+   question and explanation are always selected.
+2. Loop-free: Questions already asked in the active session are strictly excluded.
+3. Fallback-safe: If preferred follow-ups are exhausted, it gracefully falls back
+   to alternative bank questions or signals interview completion.
+4. Explainable: Returns user-friendly rationale explaining why each question was selected.
+"""
+
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union
+
+
+class AdaptiveDecision:
+    """
+    Represents the output of the adaptive selection engine.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        next_question: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
+        internal_reason: str,
+        student_explanation: str,
+    ):
+        self.next_question = next_question
+        self.internal_reason = internal_reason
+        self.student_explanation = student_explanation
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "next_question_id": self.next_question["id"] if self.next_question else None,
+            "internal_reason": self.internal_reason,
+            "student_explanation": self.student_explanation,
+        }
+
+
+class AdaptiveEngine:
+    """
+    Coordinates question progression and concept mastery tracking.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, question_bank: Optional[Union[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]] = None):
+        """
+        Initialize the adaptive engine with an optional question bank.
+        Accepts either a list of question dicts or a mapping of id -> question dict.
+        """
+        self._bank_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        if question_bank is not None:
+            self.set_question_bank(question_bank)
+
+    def set_question_bank(self, question_bank: Union[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]) -> None:
+        """Loads or updates the active question bank."""
+        if isinstance(question_bank, dict):
+            self._bank_map = dict(question_bank)
+        elif isinstance(question_bank, list):
+            self._bank_map = {q["id"]: q for q in question_bank if isinstance(q, dict) and "id" in q}
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid question_bank type: {type(question_bank).__name__}")
+
+    def get_question_by_id(self, question_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Retrieve question dict by ID."""
+        return self._bank_map.get(question_id)
+
+    def update_concept_tracking(
+        self,
+        current_question: Dict[str, Any],
+        evaluation: Dict[str, Any],
+        demonstrated_concepts: Set[str],
+        unresolved_concepts: Set[str],
+    ) -> Tuple[Set[str], Set[str]]:
+        """
+        Updates session-level concept mastery based on evaluation outcome.
+        
+        Rules:
+        - Score >= 8 and no critical misconceptions:
+            Concepts of current question are marked demonstrated and removed from unresolved.
+        - Score < 8, or missing concepts, or misconceptions present:
+            Missing concepts and misconceptions are added to unresolved concepts.
+        """
+        score = evaluation.get("score", 0)
+        misconceptions = evaluation.get("misconceptions", [])
+        missing = evaluation.get("missing_concepts", [])
+        question_concepts = set(current_question.get("concepts", []))
+
+        # Check for strong mastery
+        if score >= 8 and len(misconceptions) == 0:
+            demonstrated_concepts.update(question_concepts)
+            # Remove any concepts now demonstrated
+            unresolved_concepts.difference_update(question_concepts)
+        else:
+            # Add identified gaps to unresolved
+            for item in missing:
+                unresolved_concepts.add(item)
+            for item in misconceptions:
+                unresolved_concepts.add(f"Misconception: {item}")
+            # If weak answer (score <= 4), track current question concepts as needing work
+            if score <= 4:
+                for c in question_concepts:
+                    if c not in demonstrated_concepts:
+                        unresolved_concepts.add(c)
+
+        return demonstrated_concepts, unresolved_concepts
+
+    def select_next_question(
+        self,
+        current_question: Dict[str, Any],
+        evaluation: Dict[str, Any],
+        asked_question_ids: Union[Set[str], List[str]],
+        question_bank: Optional[Union[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
+    ) -> AdaptiveDecision:
+        """
+        Selects the next interview question deterministically based on student performance.
+
+        Parameters:
+            current_question: The question just completed.
+            evaluation: The validated evaluation result from evaluator.py.
+            asked_question_ids: IDs already presented in the current session (to prevent repetition).
+            question_bank: Optional override for the question bank.
+
+        Returns:
+            AdaptiveDecision with next_question, internal_reason, and student_explanation.
+        """
+        if question_bank is not None:
+            self.set_question_bank(question_bank)
+
+        if not self._bank_map:
+            return AdaptiveDecision(
+                next_question=None,
+                internal_reason="bank_empty",
+                student_explanation="Question bank is empty.",
+            )
+
+        asked_set = set(asked_question_ids)
+        score = evaluation.get("score", 0)
+        action = evaluation.get("recommended_action", "targeted_follow_up")
+        misconceptions = evaluation.get("misconceptions", [])
+        missing_concepts = evaluation.get("missing_concepts", [])
+
+        # Priority candidates from current question metadata
+        direct_follow_ups = [
+            qid for qid in current_question.get("follow_up_ids", [])
+            if qid in self._bank_map and qid not in asked_set
+        ]
+        fallback_id = current_question.get("fallback_follow_up_id")
+        fallback_candidate = (
+            self._bank_map[fallback_id]
+            if fallback_id and fallback_id in self._bank_map and fallback_id not in asked_set
+            else None
+        )
+
+        current_difficulty = current_question.get("difficulty", "medium")
+        current_topic = current_question.get("topic", "Stacks")
+
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        # Path A: Strong response (Score >= 8, action == "progress")
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        if action == "progress" or (score >= 8 and not misconceptions):
+            # Prefer higher difficulty or equal difficulty among direct follow-ups
+            candidate = self._pick_progressive_candidate(direct_follow_ups, current_difficulty)
+
+            if candidate:
+                diff_label = candidate.get("difficulty", "next")
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=candidate,
+                    internal_reason="mastery_demonstrated",
+                    student_explanation=f"Great explanation! Advancing to a {diff_label}-level question on {candidate.get('topic', current_topic)}.",
+                )
+
+            # If direct follow-ups exhausted, pick unasked question of higher difficulty or other topic
+            candidate = self._find_unasked_progressive_in_bank(asked_set, current_topic)
+            if candidate:
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=candidate,
+                    internal_reason="mastery_demonstrated_alternative",
+                    student_explanation="Solid grasp of this concept. Moving to explore the next topic area.",
+                )
+
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        # Path B: Critical misconception / Foundational gap (Score <= 4, action == "scaffold_hint")
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        elif action == "scaffold_hint" or score <= 4 or len(misconceptions) > 0:
+            # 1. Prefer fallback question if it exists and hasn't been asked
+            if fallback_candidate:
+                misconception_note = misconceptions[0] if misconceptions else "this foundational concept"
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=fallback_candidate,
+                    internal_reason="critical_misconception" if misconceptions else "foundational_gap",
+                    student_explanation=f"Selected a foundational question to help clarify: {misconception_note}.",
+                )
+
+            # 2. Prefer an easy question on the same topic
+            easy_candidate = self._find_unasked_by_criteria(asked_set, topic=current_topic, difficulty="easy")
+            if easy_candidate:
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=easy_candidate,
+                    internal_reason="foundational_scaffold",
+                    student_explanation=f"Let's step back and reinforce the fundamentals of {current_topic}.",
+                )
+
+            # 3. Any direct follow-up
+            if direct_follow_ups:
+                candidate = self._bank_map[direct_follow_ups[0]]
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=candidate,
+                    internal_reason="scaffold_fallback",
+                    student_explanation="Let's practice a related aspect of this data structure.",
+                )
+
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        # Path C: Partial understanding (Score 5-7, action == "targeted_follow_up")
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        else:
+            gap_summary = missing_concepts[0] if missing_concepts else "key operation mechanics"
+
+            # 1. Look for direct follow-up that addresses the missing concept
+            matching_direct = self._find_follow_up_matching_concepts(direct_follow_ups, missing_concepts)
+            if matching_direct:
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=matching_direct,
+                    internal_reason="targeted_follow_up",
+                    student_explanation=f"Follow-up selected to practice: {gap_summary}.",
+                )
+
+            # 2. Any direct follow-up
+            if direct_follow_ups:
+                candidate = self._bank_map[direct_follow_ups[0]]
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=candidate,
+                    internal_reason="targeted_follow_up",
+                    student_explanation=f"Follow-up selected to reinforce: {gap_summary}.",
+                )
+
+            # 3. Fallback candidate
+            if fallback_candidate:
+                return AdaptiveDecision(
+                    next_question=fallback_candidate,
+                    internal_reason="targeted_fallback",
+                    student_explanation=f"Practicing related principles for {current_topic}.",
+                )
+
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        # Exhaustion & General Bank Fallback (Loop Prevention)
+        # -------------------------------------------------------------
+        # If no specific follow-up matched, pick any unasked question in the bank
+        general_candidate = self._find_any_unasked(asked_set, preferred_topic=current_topic)
+        if general_candidate:
+            return AdaptiveDecision(
+                next_question=general_candidate,
+                internal_reason="bank_coverage",
+                student_explanation=f"Next question selected to broaden coverage of {general_candidate.get('topic', 'DSA')}.",
+            )
+
+        # All questions in bank have been asked
+        return AdaptiveDecision(
+            next_question=None,
+            internal_reason="interview_complete",
+            student_explanation="All interview questions have been completed! Generating your final report.",
+        )
+
+    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Internal Helpers
+    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _pick_progressive_candidate(
+        self, candidate_ids: List[str], current_difficulty: str
+    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Picks a follow-up prioritizing harder or equal difficulty."""
+        diff_rank = {"easy": 1, "medium": 2, "hard": 3}
+        current_rank = diff_rank.get(current_difficulty, 2)
+
+        higher = []
+        equal = []
+        lower = []
+
+        for qid in candidate_ids:
+            q = self._bank_map[qid]
+            rank = diff_rank.get(q.get("difficulty", "medium"), 2)
+            if rank > current_rank:
+                higher.append(q)
+            elif rank == current_rank:
+                equal.append(q)
+            else:
+                lower.append(q)
+
+        if higher:
+            return higher[0]
+        if equal:
+            return equal[0]
+        if lower:
+            return lower[0]
+        return None
+
+    def _find_follow_up_matching_concepts(
+        self, candidate_ids: List[str], missing_concepts: List[str]
+    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Finds candidate whose concept tags overlap with missing concepts."""
+        missing_lower = {m.lower() for m in missing_concepts}
+        for qid in candidate_ids:
+            q = self._bank_map[qid]
+            for concept in q.get("concepts", []):
+                if any(m in concept.lower() or concept.lower() in m for m in missing_lower):
+                    return q
+        return None
+
+    def _find_unasked_by_criteria(
+        self, asked_set: Set[str], topic: Optional[str] = None, difficulty: Optional[str] = None
+    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Finds any unasked question matching topic and/or difficulty."""
+        for q in self._bank_map.values():
+            if q["id"] in asked_set:
+                continue
+            if topic and q.get("topic") != topic:
+                continue
+            if difficulty and q.get("difficulty") != difficulty:
+                continue
+            return q
+        return None
+
+    def _find_unasked_progressive_in_bank(
+        self, asked_set: Set[str], current_topic: str
+    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Finds unasked question in bank, switching topic or increasing difficulty."""
+        other_topic = "Queues" if current_topic == "Stacks" else "Stacks"
+        # Try other topic first for balanced interview
+        candidate = self._find_unasked_by_criteria(asked_set, topic=other_topic)
+        if candidate:
+            return candidate
+        # Try harder on current topic
+        candidate = self._find_unasked_by_criteria(asked_set, topic=current_topic, difficulty="hard")
+        if candidate:
+            return candidate
+        # Any remaining on current topic
+        return self._find_unasked_by_criteria(asked_set, topic=current_topic)
+
+    def _find_any_unasked(
+        self, asked_set: Set[str], preferred_topic: Optional[str] = None
+    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Finds any unasked question, preferring preferred_topic if available."""
+        if preferred_topic:
+            for q in self._bank_map.values():
+                if q["id"] not in asked_set and q.get("topic") == preferred_topic:
+                    return q
+        for q in self._bank_map.values():
+            if q["id"] not in asked_set:
+                return q
+        return None

+"""
+evaluator.py — Answer Evaluation Engine
+
+Provides the 10-point scoring rubric implementation, local rule-based evaluation,
+critical misconception detection, and structured output schema validation.
+
+PRD References: Section 9.3 (Answer evaluation), Section 10.1 (Scoring rubric), Section 10.2 (Thresholds)
+TRD References: Section 8 (Evaluation Architecture)
+"""
+
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, TypedDict
+import re
+
+
+class ScoreBreakdown(TypedDict):
+    technical_correctness: int  # 0 to 4
+    key_concepts: int           # 0 to 3
+    reasoning: int              # 0 to 2
+    clarity: int                # 0 to 1
+
+
+class EvaluationResult(TypedDict):
+    score: int
+    score_breakdown: ScoreBreakdown
+    correct_points: List[str]
+    missing_concepts: List[str]
+    misconceptions: List[str]
+    feedback: str
+    confidence: str
+    recommended_action: str
+    evaluation_provider: str
+
+
+ALLOWED_CONFIDENCE = {"high", "medium", "low"}
+ALLOWED_ACTIONS = {"progress", "targeted_follow_up", "scaffold_hint"}
+ALLOWED_PROVIDERS = {"local", "bedrock"}
+
+
+def validate_evaluation_result(result: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """
+    Validates that an evaluation result adheres strictly to the TRD schema and rubric bounds.
+    Raises ValueError if validation fails.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(result, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Evaluation result must be a dictionary, got {type(result).__name__}.")
+
+    required_keys = {
+        "score", "score_breakdown", "correct_points", "missing_concepts",
+        "misconceptions", "feedback", "confidence", "recommended_action",
+        "evaluation_provider"
+    }
+    missing = required_keys - set(result.keys())
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"Evaluation result missing required keys: {sorted(list(missing))}")
+
+    score = result["score"]
+    if not isinstance(score, int) or isinstance(score, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"Score must be an integer, got {type(score).__name__}.")
+    if not (0 <= score <= 10):
+        raise ValueError(f"Score must be between 0 and 10, got {score}.")
+
+    breakdown = result["score_breakdown"]
+    if not isinstance(breakdown, dict):
+        raise ValueError("score_breakdown must be a dictionary.")
+
+    breakdown_keys = {"technical_correctness", "key_concepts", "reasoning", "clarity"}
+    missing_b = breakdown_keys - set(breakdown.keys())
+    if missing_b:
+        raise ValueError(f"score_breakdown missing required keys: {sorted(list(missing_b))}")
+
+    tc = breakdown["technical_correctness"]
+    kc = breakdown["key_concepts"]
+    re_pt = breakdown["reasoning"]
+    cl = breakdown["clarity"]
+
+    if not (isinstance(tc, int) and 0 <= tc <= 4):
+        raise ValueError(f"technical_correctness must be an int between 0 and 4, got {tc}.")
+    if not (isinstance(kc, int) and 0 <= kc <= 3):
+        raise ValueError(f"key_concepts must be an int between 0 and 3, got {kc}.")
+    if not (isinstance(re_pt, int) and 0 <= re_pt <= 2):
+        raise ValueError(f"reasoning must be an int between 0 and 2, got {re_pt}.")
+    if not (isinstance(cl, int) and 0 <= cl <= 1):
+        raise ValueError(f"clarity must be an int between 0 and 1, got {cl}.")
+
+    if score != (tc + kc + re_pt + cl):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Overall score ({score}) does not match sum of breakdown points ({tc + kc + re_pt + cl})."
+        )
+
+    for list_field in ["correct_points", "missing_concepts", "misconceptions"]:
+        if not isinstance(result[list_field], list):
+            raise ValueError(f"Field '{list_field}' must be a list.")
+        if not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in result[list_field]):
+            raise ValueError(f"All elements in '{list_field}' must be strings.")
+
+    if not isinstance(result["feedback"], str) or not result["feedback"].strip():
+        raise ValueError("Feedback must be a non-empty string.")
+
+    if result["confidence"] not in ALLOWED_CONFIDENCE:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid confidence '{result['confidence']}'. Allowed: {ALLOWED_CONFIDENCE}")
+
+    if result["recommended_action"] not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid recommended_action '{result['recommended_action']}'. Allowed: {ALLOWED_ACTIONS}")
+
+    if result["evaluation_provider"] not in ALLOWED_PROVIDERS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid evaluation_provider '{result['evaluation_provider']}'. Allowed: {ALLOWED_PROVIDERS}")
+
+
+class LocalEvaluator:
+    """
+    Deterministic offline evaluator implementing the 10-point scoring rubric.
+    Evaluates student answers against expected points and detects critical misconceptions.
+    """
+
+    # Conceptual keyword / phrase clusters for robust matching without external LLM
+    CONCEPT_SYNONYMS = {
+        "lifo": [r"\blifo\b", r"last[\s-]in[\s,]+first[\s-]out", r"last added.*first removed"],
+        "push": [r"\bpush\b", r"add.*top", r"insert.*top", r"place.*top"],
+        "pop": [r"\bpop\b", r"remove.*top", r"delete.*top", r"take.*top"],
+        "peek": [r"\bpeek\b", r"\btop\b", r"without removing", r"examine.*top", r"look at.*top"],
+        "underflow": [r"\bunderflow\b", r"empty (stack|queue)", r"no elements? to (pop|remove|dequeue)"],
+        "overflow": [r"\boverflow\b", r"full (stack|queue)", r"exceed.*capacity"],
+        "applications": [r"call stack", r"recursion", r"parenthes", r"undo", r"redo", r"scheduling", r"buffer", r"bfs", r"breadth-first"],
+        "time_complexity": [r"o\(1\)", r"constant time", r"o\(n\)", r"linear time"],
+        "fifo": [r"\bfifo\b", r"first[\s-]in[\s,]+first[\s-]out", r"first arrived.*first served"],
+        "enqueue": [r"\benqueue\b", r"add.*rear", r"insert.*rear", r"add.*tail", r"add.*back"],
+        "dequeue": [r"\bdequeue\b", r"remove.*front", r"delete.*front", r"remove.*head"],
+        "front_rear_pointers": [r"front.*rear", r"head.*tail", r"pointers?"],
+        "circular_queue": [r"circular", r"modulo", r"%\s*capacity", r"wraparound", r"false overflow"],
+        "monotonic_stack": [r"monotonic", r"next greater", r"increasing.*decreasing"],
+        "queue_using_stacks": [r"two stacks?", r"in_stack.*out_stack", r"input.*output", r"amortized"],
+    }
+
+    # Patterns indicating reasoning & justification
+    REASONING_PATTERNS = [
+        r"\bbecause\b", r"\bsince\b", r"\btherefore\b", r"\bas a result\b",
+        r"\bdue to\b", r"\bmeaning that\b", r"\bin order to\b", r"\bwhich prevents\b",
+        r"\bso that\b", r"\bwhy\b", r"\breason\b"
+    ]
+
+    # Specific misconception detector patterns
+    MISCONCEPTION_PATTERNS = {
+        "Stack operates on First In, First Out (FIFO)": [
+            r"stack.*(fifo|first in first out)",
+            r"first in first out.*stack"
+        ],
+        "Pop removes the oldest or bottom element": [
+            r"pop.*(oldest|bottom|first added)",
+            r"removes? (the )?(oldest|bottom|first) element"
+        ],
+        "Elements can be added or removed from any arbitrary index in a standard stack": [
+            r"(add|remove|insert|access).*(any|arbitrary|middle) (index|position|element)"
+        ],
+        "Peek modifies the stack by removing the top element": [
+            r"peek.*removes?",
+            r"peek.*deletes?"
+        ],
+        "Popping an empty stack returns the last pushed item": [
+            r"pop.*empty.*returns? (the )?last"
+        ],
+        "Breadth-first search (BFS) uses a stack by default": [
+            r"bfs.*uses? (a )?stack",
+            r"breadth-first.*uses? (a )?stack"
+        ],
+        "The call stack operates as First In, First Out": [
+            r"call stack.*(fifo|first in first out)"
+        ],
+        "Push or pop in a stack requires O(n) linear time because elements must shift": [
+            r"(push|pop).*requires? o\(n\)",
+            r"(push|pop).*shifts? (all )?elements"
+        ],
+        "Array and linked list implementations have identical memory overhead": [
+            r"(array|linked list).*identical memory"
+        ],
+        "A nested while-loop inside the traversal automatically makes the algorithm O(n^2)": [
+            r"nested (while|loop).*makes? (it |the algorithm )?o\(n\^2\)",
+            r"monotonic.*is o\(n\^2\)"
+        ],
+        "A monotonic stack requires sorting the entire array first": [
+            r"monotonic.*requires? sorting",
+            r"sort the array first"
+        ],
+        "Queue operates on Last In, First Out (LIFO)": [
+            r"queue.*(lifo|last in first out)"
+        ],
+        "Enqueue and dequeue happen at the same end of the data structure": [
+            r"(enqueue|dequeue).*same end",
+            r"insert.*remove.*same end"
+        ],
+        "Rear pointer points to the next item to be removed": [
+            r"rear.*(points? to.*removed|removes?)"
+        ],
+        "Dequeuing from an empty queue returns the front element from a previous session": [
+            r"dequeue.*empty.*returns?.*previous"
+        ],
+        "Linear queues automatically shift all elements on every dequeue without performance cost": [
+            r"linear queue.*shifts?.*without (cost|overhead)"
+        ],
+        "Circular queues require a circular doubly linked list": [
+            r"circular queue.*requires? (a )?circular doubly"
+        ],
+        "Depth-First Search (DFS) relies on a queue": [
+            r"dfs.*relies on (a )?queue",
+            r"depth-first.*uses? (a )?queue"
+        ],
+        "LIFO order is needed for fair printer job spooling": [
+            r"printer.*(lifo|last in first out)"
+        ],
+        "Transferring elements back and forth on every single dequeue or enqueue is required": [
+            r"transfer.*back and forth.*every (single )?(dequeue|enqueue)"
+        ],
+        "The worst-case O(n) transfer means the average/amortized performance is also O(n)": [
+            r"(amortized|average).*performance is (also )?o\(n\)"
+        ],
+    }
+
+    def evaluate(self, question: Dict[str, Any], answer: str) -> EvaluationResult:
+        """
+        Evaluates a student's answer for a given question using the 10-point rubric.
+        """
+        cleaned_answer = (answer or "").strip()
+
+        # Handle empty answer
+        if not cleaned_answer:
+            return self._handle_empty_answer(question)
+
+        lower_answer = cleaned_answer.lower()
+
+        # 1. Detect critical misconceptions
+        detected_misconceptions = self._detect_misconceptions(question, lower_answer)
+
+        # 2. Evaluate expected points coverage
+        expected_points = question.get("expected_points", [])
+        matched_points, missing_points = self._match_expected_points(expected_points, lower_answer)
+
+        # 3. Calculate rubric components
+        coverage_ratio = len(matched_points) / max(len(expected_points), 1)
+
+        # Technical correctness (0-4)
+        if detected_misconceptions:
+            tc = max(0, min(1, int(coverage_ratio * 4) - 1))
+        else:
+            tc = int(round(coverage_ratio * 4))
+
+        # Key concepts (0-3)
+        concepts = question.get("concepts", [])
+        matched_concepts = self._match_concepts(concepts, lower_answer)
+        concept_ratio = len(matched_concepts) / max(len(concepts), 1)
+        if detected_misconceptions:
+            kc = min(1, int(round(concept_ratio * 3)))
+        else:
+            kc = int(round(concept_ratio * 3))
+
+        # Reasoning (0-2)
+        if detected_misconceptions:
+            re_pt = 0
+        else:
+            has_reasoning = any(re.search(pat, lower_answer) for pat in self.REASONING_PATTERNS)
+            re_pt = 0
+            if has_reasoning and len(matched_points) >= 1:
+                re_pt = 2 if len(matched_points) >= 2 else 1
+            elif len(matched_points) >= 2:
+                re_pt = 1
+
+        # Clarity (0-1)
+        # 1 if student writes at least one complete sentence or clear explanation
+        cl = 1 if len(cleaned_answer.split()) >= 6 else 0
+
+        # Overall score
+        score = tc + kc + re_pt + cl
+        if detected_misconceptions:
+            score = max(0, min(4, score))
+        else:
+            score = max(0, min(10, score))
+
+        # Ensure sum matches score
+        sum_components = tc + kc + re_pt + cl
+        if score != sum_components:
+            tc = max(0, min(4, score - (kc + re_pt + cl)))
+            score = tc + kc + re_pt + cl
+
+        # 4. Determine recommended action per PRD 10.2
+        if detected_misconceptions or score <= 4:
+            recommended_action = "scaffold_hint"
+            action_desc = "Let's strengthen the fundamentals with a focused follow-up."
+        elif missing_points or score <= 7:
+            recommended_action = "targeted_follow_up"
+            action_desc = "Your answer is partly correct. Let's revisit one important concept."
+        else:
+            recommended_action = "progress"
+            action_desc = "Good explanation. Let's move to the next concept."
+
+        # 5. Generate actionable feedback
+        feedback = self._build_feedback(
+            score=score,
+            matched_points=matched_points,
+            missing_points=missing_points,
+            misconceptions=detected_misconceptions,
+            action_desc=action_desc
+        )
+
+        confidence = "high" if (score >= 8 or score <= 3 or detected_misconceptions) else "medium"
+
+        result: EvaluationResult = {
+            "score": score,
+            "score_breakdown": {
+                "technical_correctness": tc,
+                "key_concepts": kc,
+                "reasoning": re_pt,
+                "clarity": cl,
+            },
+            "correct_points": matched_points,
+            "missing_concepts": missing_points,
+            "misconceptions": detected_misconceptions,
+            "feedback": feedback,
+            "confidence": confidence,
+            "recommended_action": recommended_action,
+            "evaluation_provider": "local",
+        }
+
+        # Validate result schema before returning
+        validate_evaluation_result(result)
+        return result
+
+    def _handle_empty_answer(self, question: Dict[str, Any]) -> EvaluationResult:
+        """Constructs a validated zero-score result for empty submissions."""
+        return {
+            "score": 0,
+            "score_breakdown": {
+                "technical_correctness": 0,
+                "key_concepts": 0,
+                "reasoning": 0,
+                "clarity": 0,
+            },
+            "correct_points": [],
+            "missing_concepts": list(question.get("expected_points", [])),
+            "misconceptions": [],
+            "feedback": "Write an answer before submitting. Explain the key concepts and reasoning step by step.",
+            "confidence": "high",
+            "recommended_action": "scaffold_hint",
+            "evaluation_provider": "local",
+        }
+
+    def _detect_misconceptions(self, question: Dict[str, Any], lower_answer: str) -> List[str]:
+        """Checks student answer for known critical misconceptions for the question."""
+        detected = []
+        for mis in question.get("critical_misconceptions", []):
+            patterns = self.MISCONCEPTION_PATTERNS.get(mis, [])
+            if patterns:
+                for pat in patterns:
+                    if re.search(pat, lower_answer):
+                        detected.append(mis)
+                        break
+            else:
+                # Generic fallback check if words from misconception appear in invalid assertion
+                mis_words = [w for w in mis.lower().split() if len(w) > 3]
+                if mis_words and sum(1 for w in mis_words if w in lower_answer) >= len(mis_words) * 0.75:
+                    detected.append(mis)
+        return detected
+
+    def _match_expected_points(self, expected_points: List[str], lower_answer: str) -> tuple[List[str], List[str]]:
+        """Matches student answer text against expected answer points."""
+        matched = []
+        missing = []
+
+        for pt in expected_points:
+            pt_lower = pt.lower()
+            # Extract key technical tokens from expected point
+            tokens = [t for t in re.findall(r"\b[a-z_0-9\(\)]+\b", pt_lower) if len(t) > 2 and t not in {"the", "and", "for", "with", "from", "that"}]
+            if not tokens:
+                matched.append(pt)
+                continue
+
+            # Check if majority of core tokens or conceptual phrases match
+            matched_count = sum(1 for t in tokens if t in lower_answer)
+            ratio = matched_count / len(tokens)
+
+            # Check conceptual synonym match
+            has_concept_synonym = False
+            for concept, synonyms in self.CONCEPT_SYNONYMS.items():
+                if concept in pt_lower or any(re.search(syn, pt_lower) for syn in synonyms):
+                    if any(re.search(syn, lower_answer) for syn in synonyms):
+                        has_concept_synonym = True
+                        break
+
+            if ratio >= 0.45 or has_concept_synonym:
+                matched.append(pt)
+            else:
+                missing.append(pt)
+
+        return matched, missing
+
+    def _match_concepts(self, concepts: List[str], lower_answer: str) -> List[str]:
+        """Matches topic concept tags against answer text."""
+        matched = []
+        for c in concepts:
+            c_lower = c.lower()
+            synonyms = self.CONCEPT_SYNONYMS.get(c_lower, [re.escape(c_lower)])
+            if any(re.search(syn, lower_answer) for syn in synonyms) or c_lower in lower_answer:
+                matched.append(c)
+        return matched
+
+    def _build_feedback(
+        self,
+        score: int,
+        matched_points: List[str],
+        missing_points: List[str],
+        misconceptions: List[str],
+        action_desc: str
+    ) -> str:
+        """Constructs clear, beginner-friendly feedback text."""
+        parts = []
+
+        if score >= 8:
+            parts.append(f"Strong response ({score}/10)!")
+        elif score >= 5:
+            parts.append(f"Good effort ({score}/10) with partial understanding.")
+        else:
+            parts.append(f"Foundational practice needed ({score}/10).")
+
+        if matched_points:
+            parts.append(f"Correctly explained: {'; '.join(matched_points)}.")
+
+        if misconceptions:
+            parts.append(f"Important correction: {'; '.join(misconceptions)}.")
+
+        if missing_points:
+            parts.append(f"Missing concept: {missing_points[0]}.")
+
+        parts.append(action_desc)
+        return " ".join(parts)
+
+
+def evaluate_answer(
+    question: Dict[str, Any],
+    answer: str,
+    provider: str = "local"
+) -> EvaluationResult:
+    """
+    Unified public interface for evaluating an answer per TRD Section 8.1.
+    Currently routes to LocalEvaluator (default offline).
+    """
+    if provider == "local":
+        evaluator = LocalEvaluator()
+        return evaluator.evaluate(question, answer)
+    elif provider == "bedrock":
+        # Bedrock evaluator is optional and deferred to Phase 8 per TRD Section 20
+        # Safe fallback to local evaluator if Bedrock is requested before configured
+        evaluator = LocalEvaluator()
+        result = evaluator.evaluate(question, answer)
+        result["evaluation_provider"] = "local"
+        return result
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown evaluation provider: '{provider}'. Supported: {ALLOWED_PROVIDERS}")

+"""
+EduAgent Interview Coach — Interview Session Engine & Lifecycle Coordinator
+============================================================================
+
+Coordinates session initialization, submission deduplication, hint retrieval,
+answer evaluation, and adaptive progression matching TRD Section 10 and PRD Section 9.1-9.2.
+
+Key guarantees:
+1. Framework-agnostic: Pure Python without Streamlit dependencies for clean unit testing.
+2. State serializable: InterviewSession can be exported to and imported from standard dictionaries.
+3. Deduplication: Prevents double-submission from registering duplicate attempts.
+4. Safe lifecycle: Clear transitions from "in_progress" to "completed".
+"""
+
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union
+import uuid
+
+from adaptive_engine import AdaptiveDecision, AdaptiveEngine
+from evaluator import evaluate_answer
+
+
+class InterviewSession:
+    """
+    Encapsulates all mutable state for an active technical interview session.
+    Matches TRD Section 10.2 schema.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        session_id: Optional[str] = None,
+        current_question_id: str = "stack_001",
+        attempts: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
+        demonstrated_concepts: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
+        unresolved_concepts: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
+        asked_question_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+        evaluation_provider: str = "local",
+        session_status: str = "in_progress",
+        hint_requested_for_current: bool = False,
+        hints_used_count: int = 0,
+        last_submission_hash: Optional[str] = None,
+        created_at: Optional[str] = None,
+    ):
+        self.session_id = session_id or f"edu_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
+        self.current_question_id = current_question_id
+        self.attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = attempts if attempts is not None else []
+        self.demonstrated_concepts: Set[str] = (
+            set(demonstrated_concepts) if demonstrated_concepts is not None else set()
+        )
+        self.unresolved_concepts: Set[str] = (
+            set(unresolved_concepts) if unresolved_concepts is not None else set()
+        )
+        self.asked_question_ids: List[str] = (
+            list(asked_question_ids) if asked_question_ids is not None else [current_question_id]
+        )
+        self.evaluation_provider = evaluation_provider
+        self.session_status = session_status  # "in_progress" or "completed"
+        self.hint_requested_for_current = hint_requested_for_current
+        self.hints_used_count = hints_used_count
+        self.last_submission_hash = last_submission_hash
+        self.created_at = created_at or datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
+
+    @property
+    def total_score(self) -> int:
+        """Returns the sum of all scores received across valid attempts."""
+        return sum(
+            att.get("evaluation", {}).get("score", 0)
+            for att in self.attempts
+            if isinstance(att.get("evaluation"), dict)
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def average_score(self) -> float:
+        """Returns the mean score per completed attempt (0.0 if no attempts)."""
+        valid_attempts = [
+            att for att in self.attempts
+            if isinstance(att.get("evaluation"), dict) and "score" in att["evaluation"]
+        ]
+        if not valid_attempts:
+            return 0.0
+        return round(self.total_score / len(valid_attempts), 1)
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Serializes session state to a standard dict suitable for st.session_state or JSON."""
+        return {
+            "session_id": self.session_id,
+            "current_question_id": self.current_question_id,
+            "attempts": self.attempts,
+            "demonstrated_concepts": sorted(list(self.demonstrated_concepts)),
+            "unresolved_concepts": sorted(list(self.unresolved_concepts)),
+            "asked_question_ids": list(self.asked_question_ids),
+            "evaluation_provider": self.evaluation_provider,
+            "session_status": self.session_status,
+            "hint_requested_for_current": self.hint_requested_for_current,
+            "hints_used_count": self.hints_used_count,
+            "last_submission_hash": self.last_submission_hash,
+            "created_at": self.created_at,
+        }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "InterviewSession":
+        """Reconstructs an InterviewSession instance from a serialized dict."""
+        return cls(
+            session_id=data.get("session_id"),
+            current_question_id=data.get("current_question_id", "stack_001"),
+            attempts=data.get("attempts", []),
+            demonstrated_concepts=set(data.get("demonstrated_concepts", [])),
+            unresolved_concepts=set(data.get("unresolved_concepts", [])),
+            asked_question_ids=data.get("asked_question_ids", []),
+            evaluation_provider=data.get("evaluation_provider", "local"),
+            session_status=data.get("session_status", "in_progress"),
+            hint_requested_for_current=data.get("hint_requested_for_current", False),
+            hints_used_count=data.get("hints_used_count", 0),
+            last_submission_hash=data.get("last_submission_hash"),
+            created_at=data.get("created_at"),
+        )
+
+
+class InterviewEngine:
+    """
+    Coordinates session creation, answer evaluation, question progression,
+    and completion detection.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        question_bank_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
+        question_bank: Optional[Union[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
+    ):
+        """
+        Initializes the interview engine. Loads the question bank from disk if not provided.
+        """
+        if question_bank is not None:
+            if isinstance(question_bank, list):
+                self._bank = {q["id"]: q for q in question_bank if "id" in q}
+            elif isinstance(question_bank, dict):
+                self._bank = dict(question_bank)
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("question_bank must be a list or dict.")
+        else:
+            if question_bank_path is None:
+                question_bank_path = Path(__file__).parent / "question_bank.json"
+            else:
+                question_bank_path = Path(question_bank_path)
+
+            if not question_bank_path.exists():
+                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Question bank file not found: {question_bank_path}")
+
+            with open(question_bank_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                questions_data = json.load(f)
+                self._bank = {q["id"]: q for q in questions_data if "id" in q}
+
+        if not self._bank:
+            raise ValueError("Question bank is empty. At least one question required.")
+
+        self.adaptive_engine = AdaptiveEngine(self._bank)
+
+    @property
+    def question_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._bank)
+
+    def get_question(self, question_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Retrieve question data by ID."""
+        return self._bank.get(question_id)
+
+    def start_session(
+        self,
+        first_question_id: Optional[str] = None,
+        provider: str = "local",
+    ) -> InterviewSession:
+        """
+        Starts a new interview session.
+        If first_question_id is not specified, uses 'stack_001' or the first available question.
+        """
+        if first_question_id is None:
+            first_question_id = "stack_001" if "stack_001" in self._bank else next(iter(self._bank.keys()))
+        elif first_question_id not in self._bank:
+            raise ValueError(f"Initial question ID '{first_question_id}' not found in question bank.")
+
+        return InterviewSession(
+            current_question_id=first_question_id,
+            evaluation_provider=provider,
+            session_status="in_progress",
+        )
+
+    def get_current_question(self, session: InterviewSession) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Returns the question dict for the active question in the session."""
+        return self._bank.get(session.current_question_id)
+
+    def request_hint(self, session: InterviewSession) -> str:
+        """
+        Records hint request for the current question and returns the hint text.
+        """
+        q = self.get_current_question(session)
+        if not q:
+            return "No hint available."
+
+        if not session.hint_requested_for_current:
+            session.hint_requested_for_current = True
+            session.hints_used_count += 1
+
+        return q.get("hint", "Explain the core mechanics and definition of this concept.")
+
+    def submit_answer(
+        self,
+        session: InterviewSession,
+        answer_text: str,
+        question_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], AdaptiveDecision, bool]:
+        """
+        Processes a student's answer submission.
+
+        Parameters:
+            session: The active InterviewSession.
+            answer_text: The student's written response.
+            question_id: Optional ID of the question the student intended to answer.
+
+        Returns:
+            (evaluation_result, adaptive_decision, session_completed)
+        """
+        if session.session_status == "completed":
+            raise ValueError("Cannot submit an answer to an already completed session.")
+
+        current_q = self.get_current_question(session)
+        if not current_q:
+            raise ValueError(f"Current question '{session.current_question_id}' not found in bank.")
+
+        clean_answer = answer_text.strip() if answer_text else ""
+
+        # 1. Handle empty submission safely (PRD FR-05)
+        if not clean_answer:
+            eval_result = evaluate_answer(current_q, "", provider=session.evaluation_provider)
+            decision = AdaptiveDecision(
+                next_question=current_q,
+                internal_reason="empty_submission",
+                student_explanation="Write an answer before submitting.",
+            )
+            return eval_result, decision, False
+
+        # 2. Prevent duplicate submission from rapid button clicks (PRD FR-05, TRD Section 15)
+        submission_hash = hashlib.sha256(clean_answer.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+        # Check if identical response was submitted consecutively or for an already completed question
+        is_duplicate = False
+        if session.attempts and session.last_submission_hash == submission_hash:
+            is_duplicate = True
+        elif question_id and session.attempts and session.attempts[-1]["question_id"] == question_id:
+            is_duplicate = True
+
+        if is_duplicate and session.attempts:
+            last_attempt = session.attempts[-1]
+            last_eval = last_attempt["evaluation"]
+            last_decision_dict = last_attempt["adaptive_decision"]
+            next_q = (
+                self.get_question(last_decision_dict.get("next_question_id"))
+                if last_decision_dict.get("next_question_id")
+                else None
+            )
+            restored_decision = AdaptiveDecision(
+                next_question=next_q,
+                internal_reason="duplicate_submission",
+                student_explanation=last_decision_dict.get("student_explanation", ""),
+            )
+            return last_eval, restored_decision, (session.session_status == "completed")
+
+        # 3. Evaluate the answer using rubric and local evaluator
+        evaluation = evaluate_answer(
+            current_q,
+            clean_answer,
+            provider=session.evaluation_provider,
+        )
+
+        # 4. Update session-level concept tracking
+        self.adaptive_engine.update_concept_tracking(
+            current_q,
+            evaluation,
+            session.demonstrated_concepts,
+            session.unresolved_concepts,
+        )
+
+        # 5. Adaptively select the next question
+        decision = self.adaptive_engine.select_next_question(
+            current_question=current_q,
+            evaluation=evaluation,
+            asked_question_ids=session.asked_question_ids,
+        )
+
+        # 6. Record attempt history
+        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "question_id": current_q["id"],
+            "question_text": current_q.get("question", ""),
+            "topic": current_q.get("topic", "DSA"),
+            "difficulty": current_q.get("difficulty", "medium"),
+            "student_answer": clean_answer,
+            "hint_used": session.hint_requested_for_current,
+            "evaluation": evaluation,
+            "adaptive_decision": decision.to_dict(),
+            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        }
+        session.attempts.append(attempt_record)
+        session.last_submission_hash = submission_hash
+
+        # 7. Update session lifecycle
+        if decision.next_question is None:
+            session.session_status = "completed"
+            is_completed = True
+        else:
+            session.current_question_id = decision.next_question["id"]
+            if decision.next_question["id"] not in session.asked_question_ids:
+                session.asked_question_ids.append(decision.next_question["id"])
+            session.hint_requested_for_current = False
+            is_completed = False
+
+        return evaluation, decision, is_completed
+
+    def end_session(self, session: InterviewSession) -> None:
+        """Explicitly ends the interview session."""
+        session.session_status = "completed"

+"""
+EduAgent Interview Coach — Alexa+ Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
+======================================================================
+
+Self-hosted Model Context Protocol server exposing four standardized tools
+for Alexa+ Agent Skills and autonomous agents:
+1. `get_interview_question`: Retrieve questions by topic, difficulty, or question ID.
+2. `evaluate_student_answer`: Grade a candidate's explanation against the 10-point rubric.
+3. `get_session_weaknesses`: Inspect unresolved concepts and misconceptions.
+4. `generate_revision_report`: Produce a comprehensive performance report with study advice.
+
+Supports:
+- JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol conforming to the Model Context Protocol standard.
+- `stdio` transport for direct local agent execution.
+- HTTP / SSE transport for remote Alexa+ agent invocations.
+- Deterministic, offline-first execution with strict schema validation.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import http.server
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from adaptive_engine import AdaptiveEngine
+from evaluator import evaluate_answer, validate_evaluation_result
+from interview_engine import InterviewEngine, InterviewSession
+from report_generator import ReportGenerator
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Question Bank Loader
+# =============================================================================
+
+def load_question_bank(bank_path: str = "question_bank.json") -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load question bank from JSON file into a lookup dictionary keyed by ID."""
+    if not os.path.isabs(bank_path):
+        base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+        bank_path = os.path.join(base_dir, bank_path)
+    with open(bank_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        questions: List[Dict[str, Any]] = json.load(f)
+    return {q["id"]: q for q in questions}
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Tool Definitions & Schema Registry
+# =============================================================================
+
+MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION = "2024-11-05"
+SERVER_NAME = "eduagent-interview-coach-mcp"
+SERVER_VERSION = "1.0.0"
+
+TOOLS_REGISTRY: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
+    {
+        "name": "get_interview_question",
+        "description": (
+            "Retrieve an interview question from the reviewed Stacks and Queues question bank "
+            "for technical interview practice. Optionally filter by topic ('Stacks'/'Queues'), "
+            "difficulty ('easy'/'medium'/'hard'), or specific question_id."
+        ),
+        "inputSchema": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "topic": {
+                    "type": "string",
+                    "enum": ["Stacks", "Queues"],
+                    "description": "Filter by DSA topic (Stacks or Queues)",
+                },
+                "difficulty": {
+                    "type": "string",
+                    "enum": ["easy", "medium", "hard"],
+                    "description": "Filter by difficulty level (easy, medium, or hard)",
+                },
+                "question_id": {
+                    "type": "string",
+                    "description": "Specific question ID to retrieve (e.g., 'stack_001')",
+                },
+            },
+        },
+    },
+    {
+        "name": "evaluate_student_answer",
+        "description": (
+            "Evaluate a candidate's written or spoken technical explanation against the 10-point "
+            "rubric (Correctness 0-4, Concepts 0-3, Reasoning 0-2, Clarity 0-1), identifying correct "
+            "points, missing concepts, critical misconceptions, and next action."
+        ),
+        "inputSchema": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "question_id": {
+                    "type": "string",
+                    "description": "The unique identifier of the question being answered",
+                },
+                "student_answer": {
+                    "type": "string",
+                    "description": "The candidate's typed or spoken technical explanation",
+                },
+            },
+            "required": ["question_id", "student_answer"],
+        },
+    },
+    {
+        "name": "get_session_weaknesses",
+        "description": (
+            "Retrieve the candidate's tracked concept gaps, unresolved topics, and identified "
+            "misconceptions from the active interview session."
+        ),
+        "inputSchema": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {},
+        },
+    },
+    {
+        "name": "generate_revision_report",
+        "description": (
+            "Generate a comprehensive post-interview performance report, including total score, "
+            "performance tier, demonstrated strengths, unresolved gaps, and prioritized study recommendations."
+        ),
+        "inputSchema": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {},
+        },
+    },
+]
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Core MCP Server Implementation
+# =============================================================================
+
+class MCPServer:
+    """
+    Self-hosted Model Context Protocol server managing session state and
+    tool dispatch for Alexa+ Agent Skills.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, question_bank_path: str = "question_bank.json") -> None:
+        self.question_bank = load_question_bank(question_bank_path)
+        self.adaptive_engine = AdaptiveEngine()
+        self.report_generator = ReportGenerator()
+        self.session = InterviewSession(
+            session_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            current_question_id="stack_001",
+        )
+
+    def reset_session(self, first_question_id: str = "stack_001") -> None:
+        """Reset the server session with a clean state."""
+        if first_question_id not in self.question_bank:
+            first_question_id = next(iter(self.question_bank.keys()))
+        self.session = InterviewSession(
+            session_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            current_question_id=first_question_id,
+        )
+
+    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Tool Handlers
+    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def tool_get_interview_question(
+        self,
+        topic: Optional[str] = None,
+        difficulty: Optional[str] = None,
+        question_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """
+        Handler for `get_interview_question`.
+        Returns candidate-safe question data (omitting internal grading rubrics).
+        """
+        target_q: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
+
+        if question_id:
+            if question_id not in self.question_bank:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Question ID '{question_id}' not found in question bank. "
+                    f"Available IDs: {list(self.question_bank.keys())}"
+                )
+            target_q = self.question_bank[question_id]
+        else:
+            # Filter candidates by topic / difficulty
+            candidates = list(self.question_bank.values())
+            if topic:
+                candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("topic", "").lower() == topic.lower()]
+            if difficulty:
+                candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("difficulty", "").lower() == difficulty.lower()]
+
+            if not candidates:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"No questions matched filter (topic={topic}, difficulty={difficulty})."
+                )
+
+            # Prefer unasked questions from active session
+            unasked = [c for c in candidates if c["id"] not in self.session.asked_question_ids]
+            target_q = unasked[0] if unasked else candidates[0]
+
+        # Update active session pointer
+        self.session.current_question_id = target_q["id"]
+
+        return {
+            "id": target_q["id"],
+            "topic": target_q.get("topic", "DSA"),
+            "difficulty": target_q.get("difficulty", "medium"),
+            "question": target_q["question"],
+            "hint": target_q.get("hint", ""),
+        }
+
+    def tool_evaluate_student_answer(
+        self,
+        question_id: str,
+        student_answer: str,
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """
+        Handler for `evaluate_student_answer`.
+        Evaluates answer, records session attempt, updates concept tracking, and returns rubric feedback.
+        """
+        if not question_id:
+            raise ValueError("question_id is required.")
+        if question_id not in self.question_bank:
+            raise ValueError(f"Question ID '{question_id}' not found in question bank.")
+
+        question = self.question_bank[question_id]
+
+        # Perform deterministic local evaluation
+        eval_result = evaluate_answer(question, student_answer, provider="local")
+        validate_evaluation_result(eval_result)
+
+        # Update concept mastery tracking
+        self.adaptive_engine.update_concept_tracking(
+            current_question=question,
+            evaluation=eval_result,
+            demonstrated_concepts=self.session.demonstrated_concepts,
+            unresolved_concepts=self.session.unresolved_concepts,
+        )
+
+        # Record attempt in active session
+        attempt = {
+            "question_id": question_id,
+            "student_answer": student_answer,
+            "evaluation": eval_result,
+        }
+        self.session.attempts.append(attempt)
+        if question_id not in self.session.asked_question_ids:
+            self.session.asked_question_ids.append(question_id)
+
+        return eval_result
+
+    def tool_get_session_weaknesses(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """
+        Handler for `get_session_weaknesses`.
+        Returns unresolved concepts and detected misconceptions from the active session.
+        """
+        misconceptions: List[str] = []
+        for attempt in self.session.attempts:
+            eval_res = attempt.get("evaluation", {})
+            for m in eval_res.get("misconceptions", []):
+                if m not in misconceptions:
+                    misconceptions.append(m)
+
+        return {
+            "session_id": self.session.session_id,
+            "total_attempts": len(self.session.attempts),
+            "unresolved_concepts": sorted(list(self.session.unresolved_concepts)),
+            "demonstrated_concepts": sorted(list(self.session.demonstrated_concepts)),
+            "misconceptions_detected": misconceptions,
+        }
+
+    def tool_generate_revision_report(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """
+        Handler for `generate_revision_report`.
+        Returns complete post-interview performance analysis and study recommendations.
+        """
+        report = self.report_generator.generate_report(self.session)
+        markdown = self.report_generator.generate_markdown_report(report)
+        report["markdown_report"] = markdown
+        return report
+
+    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # JSON-RPC 2.0 Dispatcher
+    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def dispatch(self, request: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """
+        Process a JSON-RPC 2.0 request and return the JSON-RPC response dictionary.
+        Returns None for notifications (requests without an 'id').
+        """
+        req_id = request.get("id")
+        method = request.get("method")
+        params = request.get("params", {})
+
+        # Handle notifications (no response required)
+        if req_id is None and method in ("notifications/initialized", "initialized"):
+            return None
+
+        # Helper to construct error response
+        def make_error(code: int, message: str, data: Any = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+            err_dict: Dict[str, Any] = {"code": code, "message": message}
+            if data is not None:
+                err_dict["data"] = data
+            return {
+                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
+                "id": req_id,
+                "error": err_dict,
+            }
+
+        # Helper to construct success response
+        def make_result(result: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+            return {
+                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
+                "id": req_id,
+                "result": result,
+            }
+
+        # 1. initialize
+        if method == "initialize":
+            return make_result({
+                "protocolVersion": MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
+                "capabilities": {
+                    "tools": {},
+                },
+                "serverInfo": {
+                    "name": SERVER_NAME,
+                    "version": SERVER_VERSION,
+                },
+            })
+
+        # 2. ping
+        if method == "ping":
+            return make_result({})
+
+        # 3. tools/list
+        if method == "tools/list":
+            return make_result({
+                "tools": TOOLS_REGISTRY,
+            })
+
+        # 4. tools/call
+        if method == "tools/call":
+            tool_name = params.get("name")
+            arguments = params.get("arguments", {})
+
+            if not tool_name:
+                return make_error(-32602, "Missing tool name in params")
+
+            try:
+                if tool_name == "get_interview_question":
+                    res = self.tool_get_interview_question(
+                        topic=arguments.get("topic"),
+                        difficulty=arguments.get("difficulty"),
+                        question_id=arguments.get("question_id"),
+                    )
+                elif tool_name == "evaluate_student_answer":
+                    res = self.tool_evaluate_student_answer(
+                        question_id=arguments.get("question_id", ""),
+                        student_answer=arguments.get("student_answer", ""),
+                    )
+                elif tool_name == "get_session_weaknesses":
+                    res = self.tool_get_session_weaknesses()
+                elif tool_name == "generate_revision_report":
+                    res = self.tool_generate_revision_report()
+                else:
+                    return make_error(-32601, f"Unknown tool: '{tool_name}'")
+
+                return make_result({
+                    "content": [
+                        {
+                            "type": "text",
+                            "text": json.dumps(res, indent=2),
+                        }
+                    ],
+                    "isError": False,
+                })
+
+            except ValueError as ve:
+                return make_result({
+                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": f"Validation Error: {str(ve)}"}],
+                    "isError": True,
+                })
+            except Exception as exc:
+                return make_result({
+                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": f"Execution Error: {str(exc)}"}],
+                    "isError": True,
+                })
+
+        # Unknown method
+        return make_error(-32601, f"Method not found: '{method}'")
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Transports: Stdio & HTTP / SSE
+# =============================================================================
+
+def run_stdio_server(server: MCPServer) -> None:
+    """Run MCP server over standard I/O (stdio) transport."""
+    sys.stderr.write(f"[{SERVER_NAME}] Starting stdio MCP server (version {SERVER_VERSION})...\n")
+    sys.stderr.flush()
+
+    for line in sys.stdin:
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line:
+            continue
+        try:
+            req = json.loads(line)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            err_resp = {
+                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
+                "id": None,
+                "error": {"code": -32700, "message": "Parse error: Invalid JSON"},
+            }
+            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(err_resp) + "\n")
+            sys.stdout.flush()
+            continue
+
+        resp = server.dispatch(req)
+        if resp is not None:
+            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp) + "\n")
+            sys.stdout.flush()
+
+
+def run_http_server(server: MCPServer, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8000) -> None:
+    """Run lightweight HTTP/SSE JSON-RPC server using standard library."""
+    class MCPHTTPRequestHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
+            # Suppress default noisy access logs to keep stderr clean
+            pass
+
+        def do_OPTIONS(self) -> None:
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
+            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
+            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
+            self.end_headers()
+
+        def do_POST(self) -> None:
+            content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
+            body = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode("utf-8")
+            try:
+                req = json.loads(body)
+                resp = server.dispatch(req)
+                resp_bytes = json.dumps(resp).encode("utf-8") if resp else b""
+
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_bytes)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                if resp_bytes:
+                    self.wfile.write(resp_bytes)
+            except Exception as e:
+                err_resp = {
+                    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
+                    "id": None,
+                    "error": {"code": -32603, "message": f"Internal error: {str(e)}"},
+                }
+                resp_bytes = json.dumps(err_resp).encode("utf-8")
+                self.send_response(500)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(resp_bytes)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(resp_bytes)
+
+        def do_GET(self) -> None:
+            if self.path in ("/sse", "/events"):
+                # Basic SSE endpoint for Alexa+ agent streaming
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+                self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
+                self.send_header("Connection", "keep-alive")
+                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(b": keepalive\n\n")
+                self.wfile.flush()
+            else:
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(
+                    f"{SERVER_NAME} v{SERVER_VERSION} is running. Send POST JSON-RPC to this endpoint.".encode("utf-8")
+                )
+
+    httpd = http.server.HTTPServer((host, port), MCPHTTPRequestHandler)
+    sys.stderr.write(f"[{SERVER_NAME}] HTTP MCP Server listening at http://{host}:{port}/\n")
+    sys.stderr.flush()
+    try:
+        httpd.serve_forever()
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        pass
+    finally:
+        httpd.server_close()
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# CLI Entry Point
+# =============================================================================
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """CLI entry point parsing transport options."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="EduAgent Interview Coach MCP Server")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--transport",
+        choices=["stdio", "sse", "http"],
+        default=os.environ.get("MCP_TRANSPORT", "stdio"),
+        help="MCP transport protocol (stdio or sse/http, default: stdio)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--host",
+        default=os.environ.get("MCP_SERVER_HOST", "127.0.0.1"),
+        help="Host address for HTTP transport (default: 127.0.0.1)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--port",
+        type=int,
+        default=int(os.environ.get("MCP_SERVER_PORT", "8000")),
+        help="Port number for HTTP transport (default: 8000)",
+    )
+
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    server = MCPServer()
+
+    if args.transport in ("sse", "http"):
+        run_http_server(server, host=args.host, port=args.port)
+    else:
+        run_stdio_server(server)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
